claim: Do 134 IEA data-centre grid policies show that the measures work?
sourceFinding: The IEA surveyed 134 data-centre electricity integration policies and regulations, with nearly 40% announced or implemented over the prior year.
evidenceLimits: Counting policies does not assess their enforcement, effectiveness or actual consumer electricity costs.
nextEvidenceTrigger: Evidence on implementation, connection delays, grid capacity and cost allocation.
